# Bootstrap contract — 20261111-v1 / S1

This handoff releases only independent preparation under disjoint bootstrap quotas. The source anchor is `1cde2ff7a71bcf7aecb5d030917b577165135d38`; the protocol is `2689c516d63488be37de678cc853dd4556fd5c13`. No candidate implementation has executed.

S1 is enumerating the entire tree. Inventory, source-to-need bindings, the full criterion catalogue and production allocation follow in an immutable revision. S2–S4 may inspect and prepare concrete cases now; dependent L1–L4 production waits for the frozen inventory and interfaces. S5 may prepare its independent review protocol. All product acceptance remains open.

A logical work packet counts a bounded root task or native agent turn, not a token, dollar or physical provider attempt. Preserve uncertain reservations. The root preparation started before a reserving adapter and is explicitly retrospective. AC-08 is not satisfied by these files.

All sessions write only their own branch and prefix. Shared changes are proposals for S5 serial integration. Historical objects and verdicts remain unchanged. No external model APIs, production activation, PR, merge or force-push are authorized by this handoff.
